entries.name: M101 · 102 infrared wavelengths
entries.description: The Pinwheel Galaxy in the official IRSA 102-plane SPHEREx mosaic. Move through wavelength, inspect real samples and coverage, then search observations at the same sky position. This combined map is not a time sequence.
entries.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/IPAC · IRSA Mosaic Tool tutorial cube. Infrared light mapped to visible display shades; no NASA endorsement.

entries.name: Cygnus · stars & dust
entries.mapping: Published false-color mapping: blue 0.8 μm, green 1.63 μm, red 2.6 μm.
entries.description: An official SPHEREx view into the dusty disk of the Milky Way. This published composite is a visual reference, with no calibrated pixel WCS or temporal measurements in SKYSHIFT.
entries.centre_context: Published target centre, not a per-pixel WCS or propagated source position.

entries.name: NGC 1760 · star-forming nebula
entries.mapping: Published single-wavelength map at 3.29 μm, assembled from four preparatory pointings; not four time frames.
entries.description: A genuine SPHEREx view of a star-forming nebula in the Large Magellanic Cloud. The published image highlights dust emission near 3.29 μm. Its pixels are not treated as calibrated astrometry or photometry in SKYSHIFT.
entries.centre_context: Published target centre, not a per-pixel WCS or propagated source position.
